findings.what: The new Ok(Err) arm only calls child.kill() and never calls kill_group(leader), so the dog's process group is not swept on a failed read. This contradicts both the commit subject and the new comment that says both failure arms take the ladder with the group first. Grandchildren that were left running on a read failure stay alive.
